description: At the end of each round, damages everything by 2 with a chance to lower a random stat as well.

desc_texts.en: At the end of each round, damages everything by 2 with a chance to lower a random stat as well.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​结束​时，​全场​都​会​受到​2点​伤害，​而且​有​几率​随机令​1​项属性​降低。

description: 2-4 aliens spawn in each battle. Aliens are invading!

desc_texts.en: 2-4 aliens spawn in each battle. Aliens are invading!
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​都​会​出现​2到​4​个​外星​人。​外星​人​来​侵略啦！

description: A few bramble patches spawn in each battle, but something is strange about them...

desc_texts.en: A few bramble patches spawn in each battle, but something is strange about them...
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗会​出现​几​片​灌木，​只是​看​起来​不​太​对​劲​……

description: 1-2 extra birds spawn in each battle.

desc_texts.en: 1-2 extra birds spawn in each battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​会额​外​出现​1​到​2​只鸟。

description: 2-4 birds spawn in each battle. All birds are stronger, and angry!

desc_texts.en: 2-4 birds spawn in each battle. All birds are stronger, and angry!
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗会​出现​2到​4​个​鸟。​鸟类​全部​变强，​也​更加​暴躁！

description: All units have +3 Health Regen. Persistent Holy Element.

desc_texts.en: All units have +3 Health Regen. Persistent Holy Element.
desc_texts.zh: 所有​单位​的​生命​自然​恢复​+​3。​场​上​持续​出现​神圣​元素。

description: Persistent Ice Element. At the end of each round, wind blows everything 1 space in a random direction. After each turn, there's a chance for a random lightning strike.

desc_texts.en: Persistent Ice Element. At the end of each round, wind blows everything 1 space in a random direction. After each turn, there's a chance for a random lightning strike.
desc_texts.zh: 场​上​持续​出现​冰​元素。​每​轮​结束​时，​风会​把​所有​东西​随机​吹动​1格。​每​个​回合​结束​后，​有​几率​落​下​闪电，​随机劈​中​1​个​方格。

description: A random unit in each battle has a bounty. A Bounty Hunter is here to collect.

desc_texts.en: A random unit in each battle has a bounty. A Bounty Hunter is here to collect.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​都​会​随机​有​1​个​单位​被​悬赏。​赏金​猎​手来​领赏​金​了。

description: All allies have +2 luck.

desc_texts.en: All allies have +2 luck.
desc_texts.zh: 友方​全​体​运气​+​2。

description: All units have a 25% chance to start each battle with Fear or Poison.

desc_texts.en: All units have a 25% chance to start each battle with Fear or Poison.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​开始​时，​所有​单位​都​有​25%​的​几率​【害怕】​或​【中​毒】。

description: The weather around here is crazy! It's different every battle!

desc_texts.en: The weather around here is crazy! It's different every battle!
desc_texts.zh: 这​边​天气​太​离谱​了！​每场​战斗​都​不​一样！

description: There is extra catnip in every battle. Find a random pill after every battle.

desc_texts.en: There is extra catnip in every battle. Find a random pill after every battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​都​会额​外​出现​一些​猫薄荷。​每场​战斗​结束​后，​都​会​随机​发现​1粒​胶囊。

description: There was an earthquake! Objects in each battle have been destroyed and there are rocks everywhere!

desc_texts.en: There was an earthquake! Objects in each battle have been destroyed and there are rocks everywhere!
desc_texts.zh: 地震​了！​每场​战斗​的​物体​都​已经​毁坏，​地​上​到​处​是​石头！

description: A mini volcano spawns in each battle.

desc_texts.en: A mini volcano spawns in each battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​都​会​出现​1​座迷​你​火山。

description: All allies have +2 luck.

desc_texts.en: All allies have +2 luck.
desc_texts.zh: 友方​全​体​运气​+​2。

description: Persistent Fire Element. Fires no longer burn out. Parts of the map are on fire.

desc_texts.en: Persistent Fire Element. Fires no longer burn out. Parts of the map are on fire.
desc_texts.zh: 场​上​持续​出现​火​元素，​火势​不​会​自行​熄灭。​地图​上​有​些​地方​着​火​了。

description: Persistent Water Element. There are a ton of extra water tiles in every battle.

desc_texts.en: Persistent Water Element. There are a ton of extra water tiles in every battle.
desc_texts.zh: 场​上​持续​出现​水​元素。​每场​战斗​都​会​出现​大量额​外​的​水方格。

description: At the end of each turn, there's a chance to get bitten for 1 damage and 1 Bleed.

desc_texts.en: At the end of each turn, there's a chance to get bitten for 1 damage and 1 Bleed.
desc_texts.zh: 每​个​回合​结束​时，​都​有​几率​被​叮，​受到​1点​伤害，​获得​1层​【出​血】。

description: All attacks and abilities have a +10% chance to miss.

desc_texts.en: All attacks and abilities have a +10% chance to miss.
desc_texts.zh: 所有​攻击​和​能力​落空​的​几率​+10%​。

description: All rocks levitate at the end of the round. Extra rocks spawn in each battle.

desc_texts.en: All rocks levitate at the end of the round. Extra rocks spawn in each battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​结束​时，​石头​都​会​漂​起来。​每场​战斗​还​会​出现额​外​的​石头。

description: 2-4 ghosts spawn in each battle. All ghosts have gone rogue!

desc_texts.en: 2-4 ghosts spawn in each battle. All ghosts have gone rogue!
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗会​出现​2到​4​个​鬼魂。​所有​鬼魂​都​失控​啦！

description: Cats do not heal after battle. All heals are reduced by 1. Can be mitigated with water.

desc_texts.en: Cats do not heal after battle. All heals are reduced by 1. Can be mitigated with water.
desc_texts.zh: 战斗​结束​后，​猫​不​会​恢复​生命。​所有​治疗​/​恢复​效果​减1。​可以​用​水缓解。

description: Persistent Water Element. There are extra water tiles in every battle.

desc_texts.en: Persistent Water Element. There are extra water tiles in every battle.
desc_texts.zh: 持续​出现​水​元素。​每场​战斗​都​会​出现额​外​的​水方格。

description: There are extra bear traps in every battle.

desc_texts.en: There are extra bear traps in every battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​都​会​出现额​外​的​捕兽夹。

description: At the end of each round, wind blows everything 10 spaces in a random direction.

desc_texts.en: At the end of each round, wind blows everything 10 spaces in a random direction.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​结束​时，​风会​把​所有​东西​随机​吹动10格。

description: All non-tiny units explode into a charmed maggot when they die.

desc_texts.en: All non-tiny units explode into a charmed maggot when they die.
desc_texts.zh: 只要​不​是​微型​单位，​死亡时​都​会​爆炸，​产生​1​个​【洗​脑】​的​蛆。

description: Some tiles will get Raptured at the end of each round during the battle. More tiles are affected every round.

desc_texts.en: Some tiles will get Raptured at the end of each round during the battle. More tiles are affected every round.
desc_texts.zh: 战​斗​期间，​每​轮​结束​时​都​会​有​一些​方格​被​提上​天。​每​轮​被​提走​的​方格​都​会​增多。

description: Persistent Fire Element. Fireballs occasionally rain down from the sky. Fires no longer burn out.

desc_texts.en: Persistent Fire Element. Fireballs occasionally rain down from the sky. Fires no longer burn out.
desc_texts.zh: 场​上​持续​出现​火​元素。​天上​偶尔落下​火球。​火势​不​会​自行​熄灭。

description: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1 with a 33% chance to Bruise.

desc_texts.en: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1 with a 33% chance to Bruise.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​结束​时，​全场​都​会​受到​1点​伤害，​同时​有​33%​的​几率​造成​【瘀​伤】。

description: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1 with a 33% chance to Bruise.

desc_texts.en: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1 with a 33% chance to Bruise.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​结束​时，​全场​都​会​受到​1点​伤害，​同时​有​33%​的​几率​造成​【瘀​伤】。

description: Jumps, throws, and projectile abilities have +2 range. All physical abilities have +1 Knockback. Other abilities that cause Knockback have +1 Knockback as well.

desc_texts.en: Jumps, throws, and projectile abilities have +2 range. All physical abilities have +1 Knockback. Other abilities that cause Knockback have +1 Knockback as well.
desc_texts.zh: 跳跃、​抛投​和​投射​类​能力​的​范围​+​2。​所有​物理​能力​的​击退​距离​+​1。​其他​会击退​的​能力击​退​距离​也​+​1。

description: After each turn there's a chance for a flaming meteor to fall onto a random tile.

desc_texts.en: After each turn there's a chance for a flaming meteor to fall onto a random tile.
desc_texts.zh: 每​个​回合​结束​后，​都​有​几率​落下​燃烧​的​流星，​随机砸​中​1​个​方格。

description: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1 with a 33% chance to Bruise.

desc_texts.en: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1 with a 33% chance to Bruise.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​结束​时，​全场​都​会​受到​1点​伤害，​同时​有​33%​的​几率​造成​【瘀​伤】。

description: There are extra land mines in every battle.

desc_texts.en: There are extra land mines in every battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​都​会​出现额​外​的​地雷。

description: There are no weather effects.

desc_texts.en: There are no weather effects.
desc_texts.zh: 没有​天气​效果。

description: A puddle of tar appears in each battle.

desc_texts.en: A puddle of tar appears in each battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​都​会​出现​一​滩​焦油。

description: There are extra tall grass and bramble tiles in every battle.

desc_texts.en: There are extra tall grass and bramble tiles in every battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​都​会​出现额​外​的​草丛​方格​和​灌木​方格。

description: All units have a 25% chance to have Madness each round.

desc_texts.en: All units have a 25% chance to have Madness each round.
desc_texts.zh: 所有​单位​每轮​都​有​25%​的​几率​【癫​狂】。

description: There are extra coins in every battle.

desc_texts.en: There are extra coins in every battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​都​会​出现额​外​的​硬币。

description: There is extra poop and sewage in every battle.

desc_texts.en: There is extra poop and sewage in every battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​都​会​出现额​外​的​大便​和​污水。

description: Persistent Water Element.

desc_texts.en: Persistent Water Element.
desc_texts.zh: 持续​出现​水​元素。

description: There are extra neutral frogs in every battle.

desc_texts.en: There are extra neutral frogs in every battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​都​会​出现额​外​的​中立​青蛙。

description: Zombies spawn at the end of each round.

desc_texts.en: Zombies spawn at the end of each round.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​结束​时会​出现​僵尸。

description: 2-4 robots spawn in each battle. All robots have gone rogue!

desc_texts.en: 2-4 robots spawn in each battle. All robots have gone rogue!
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗会​出现​2到​4​个​机器​人。​机器​人​全​都​失控​啦！

description: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1.

desc_texts.en: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​结束​时，​全场​都​会​受到​1点​伤害。

description: Persistent Ice Element.

desc_texts.en: Persistent Ice Element.
desc_texts.zh: 持续​出现​冰​元素。

description: A solar flare strikes a large area at the end of each round, Burning and inflicting Blind.

desc_texts.en: A solar flare strikes a large area at the end of each round, Burning and inflicting Blind.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​结束​时，​太阳耀​斑会​打击​一​大​片​区域，​造成​【灼​烧】​和​【瞎​眼】。

description: All units gain Stealth at the start of the battle.

desc_texts.en: All units gain Stealth at the start of the battle.
desc_texts.zh: 战斗​开始​时，​所有​单位​获得​【隐​匿】。

description: 3-6 strange eggs spawn in each battle. Kill them before they hatch!

desc_texts.en: 3-6 strange eggs spawn in each battle. Kill them before they hatch!
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗会​出现​3​到​6颗​奇怪​的​蛋。​趁着​还​没​孵​出来，​快把​它们​打烂！

description: At the end of the round, all units gain +1 Thorns.

desc_texts.en: At the end of the round, all units gain +1 Thorns.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​结束​时，​所有​单位​【尖​刺】​+​1。

description: At the end of the round, each corpse has a 25% chance to revive at half health with Madness 5.

desc_texts.en: At the end of the round, each corpse has a 25% chance to revive at half health with Madness 5.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​结束​时，​每​具​尸体​都​有​25%​的​几率​以​一半​的​生命​复活，​同时​获得​5层【癫​狂】。

description: All units gain a random status effect at the start of each round. Cats gain a random mutation at the end of each battle.

desc_texts.en: All units gain a random status effect at the start of each round. Cats gain a random mutation at the end of each battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​开始​时，​所有​单位​随机​获得​1​个​状态​效果。​每场​战斗​结束​时，​猫会​随机​获得​1​项​突变。

description: Persistent Water Element. At the end of each round, wind blows everything 1 space in a random direction. After each turn, there's a chance for a random lightning strike.

desc_texts.en: Persistent Water Element. At the end of each round, wind blows everything 1 space in a random direction. After each turn, there's a chance for a random lightning strike.
desc_texts.zh: 场​上​持续​出现​水​元素。​每​轮​结束​时，​风会​把​所有​东西​随机​吹动​1格。​每​个​回合​结束​后，​都​有​几率​落​下​闪电，​随机劈​中​1​个​方格。

description: Twisters spawn each round.

desc_texts.en: Twisters spawn each round.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​都​会​出现​龙​卷风。

description: A punching bag with Kinetic Spikes 5 spawns in each battle.

desc_texts.en: A punching bag with Kinetic Spikes 5 spawns in each battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​都​会​出现​1​个​带5​层​【动​能​尖​刺】​的​受气​包。

description: There is extra junk in every battle.

desc_texts.en: There is extra junk in every battle.
desc_texts.zh: 每场​战斗​都​会​出现额​外​的​垃圾。

description: There's lots of flies!

desc_texts.en: There's lots of flies!
desc_texts.zh: 到​处​都​是​苍蝇！

description: There is fire everywhere!

desc_texts.en: There is fire everywhere!
desc_texts.zh: 大火烧​得到​处​都​是​！

description: At the end of each round, wind blows everything 1 space in a random direction.

desc_texts.en: At the end of each round, wind blows everything 1 space in a random direction.
desc_texts.zh: 每​轮​结束​时，​风会​把​所有​东西​随机​吹动​1格。
